expectations.text: Touch targets meet platform minimums (44pt iOS / 48dp Android), using hitSlop or padding for the like button
expectations.evidence: The like button style uses width/height MIN_TOUCH, defined as Platform.select({ios:44, default:48}). The Pressable also sets hitSlop={4}. The title Pressable has minHeight: MIN_TOUCH.

expectations.text: Pull-to-refresh is implemented on the list (refreshing/onRefresh or RefreshControl)
expectations.evidence: The FlatList receives refreshControl={<RefreshControl refreshing={refreshing} onRefresh={onRefresh} />}. The component props now include refreshing and onRefresh.

expectations.text: Cards adapt to device width and safe areas instead of fixed sizes
expectations.evidence: Cards have no fixed width and the list is full-width with padding 16, so width adapts. Safe areas are only weakly handled: contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior="automatic" is set, but there is no SafeAreaView, useSafeAreaInsets or explicit inset handling, and no useWindowDimensions. The agent's summary does not claim to handle safe areas either. This is only partially met.

expectations.text: Typography sizes and color contrast are raised to readable mobile levels (the 9-11px text and #bbb on white are fixed)
expectations.evidence: Title fontSize went from 11 to 17 with lineHeight 24. Author fontSize went from 9 to 14, and its color from #bbb to #555. The title color is #111 on a #fff card.
